title: DRIFT Boundary Bundle Schema
description: Normative schema for the JSON bundle written by `drift export boundary` (to a file or, with --out -, to standard output): the boundary-visible scope, cases, decisions and projections of every contract of an area, sorted by contract id, with a dr1 digest over the canonical JSON of the bundle without its digest. Contracts of schema 0.2 and 0.3 export the same entry shape; the digest of an entry is the digest the contract reports (dr1 or dr2b).

area.description: Area name: --area, else the name inferred from the area root, else the stem of the boundary document.

contracts.description: One entry per exported contract or boundary operation, sorted by id.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the bundle without this field.

drift.description: Schema version of the bundle envelope.

approval.description: Approval state the contract reported when it was exported (for example current).

cases.description: Cases without a status, keyed by case id, without their notes.

decisions.description: Decision cards that carry a revisit_if or an owner, keyed by decision id, without their notes.

indirect.description: none, or the indirect resources of the contract.
